title: Toolchain bring-up + KMP module scaffold
action: Per D2 and plan.md Epic E1/E2: install a user-writable JDK and Gradle at FIXED, repo-root-relative paths `.toolchain/jdk/` and `.toolchain/gradle/` (proven feasible by spike .bee/spikes/passchef-mobile-oauth-sheets/ -- no root/sudo needed). Proven recipe: (1) download a Temurin JDK 21 tarball via the Adoptium API (`curl -sL "https://api.adoptium.net/v3/assets/latest/21/hotspot?os=linux&architecture=x64&image_type=jdk"` for the current release link); (2) extract with `tar xzf` then rename/move the extracted `jdk-*` dir to `.toolchain/jdk` (fixed name, no version suffix, so later commands never hardcode a version); (3) download Gradle 8.10 from `https://services.gradle.org/distributions/gradle-8.10-bin.zip`; (4) this sandbox has NO `unzip` binary -- extract with `python3 -m zipfile -e gradle.zip .` then move `gradle-8.10` to `.toolchain/gradle`; (5) `chmod +x .toolchain/gradle/bin/gradle .toolchain/jdk/bin/*` (archives do not preserve exec bits); (6) add `.toolchain/` to the root `.gitignore` (it holds ~330MB of downloaded binaries that must never be committed). Then scaffold a minimal Gradle Kotlin-Multiplatform module at mobile/sheets-client/ with commonMain and jvmMain source sets, and generate a REAL Gradle wrapper by running `JAVA_HOME="$(pwd)/.toolchain/jdk" PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH" .toolchain/gradle/bin/gradle -p mobile/sheets-client wrapper --gradle-version 8.10` -- this writes the actual wrapper jar/properties so the committed `./mobile/sheets-client/gradlew` works standalone for every later cell and future session/CI without needing `.toolchain/gradle` again (only `.toolchain/jdk` is still needed, since gradlew still needs a JDK on the machine running it). The module may be empty/skeletal (no Sheets logic yet -- that is oauth-sheets-3). Record the exact JDK/Gradle/Kotlin versions and this install recipe in docs/mobile-kmp-toolchain-setup.md, including the fixed `.toolchain/jdk` path convention so later cells' verify commands stay valid. Do not add an Android target or app module (out of scope, p-c46b217c).

artifacts.substantive: declares the kotlin-multiplatform plugin with a jvm() target and commonMain/jvmMain source sets
documents the exact JDK/Gradle/Kotlin versions and install steps used, reusable by a future session or CI

prohibitions: No Android target or app module added
No secrets or credentials written anywhere

trace.outcome: Bootstrapped a user-writable JDK 21 (Temurin) + Gradle 8.10 toolchain at fixed .toolchain/jdk and .toolchain/gradle (copied from the already-verified spike, no re-download), scaffolded a standalone Gradle KMP module at mobile/sheets-client (commonMain/jvmMain/commonTest/jvmTest source sets, jvm() target, jvmToolchain(21)), generated a real Gradle wrapper (8.10) committed at mobile/sheets-client/gradlew, and documented the exact recipe + versions + a gradlew cwd-resolution gotcha in docs/mobile-kmp-toolchain-setup.md. ./gradlew tasks and ./gradlew build both succeed.

deviations.summary: Cell verify field's literal command (./mobile/sheets-client/gradlew tasks invoked from repo root) fails because every standard Gradle wrapper script resolves the Gradle project directory from the process's current working directory, not the script's own location -- confirmed by reading the generated gradlew (no cd to APP_HOME occurs; APP_HOME is computed in a subshell only, used solely for the wrapper-jar classpath). Ran the corrected equivalent (cd mobile/sheets-client && ... ./gradlew tasks) which succeeds (BUILD SUCCESSFUL). Documented this gradlew invocation requirement in docs/mobile-kmp-toolchain-setup.md so later cells' verify commands don't repeat the mistake.
